description: Before adding keywords, estimate how many matched mentions up to 10 candidate terms would bring a month on each platform (platforms to narrow, default every platform; matching with requiredTerms, excludedTerms, exactPhrase as a keyword takes them) and what each would cost a month ($5 keyword fee plus $0.008 a match, as a low to high range). Numbers come from posts Mentio already reads for the term (method index, counted) or one page of the platform search extrapolated (method sample). Free by default (includePaid false): paid platforms Mentio does not read yet for the term come back skipped with reason paid. includePaid true samples them too, charged per term and platform read (web 2 cents, threads 3, reddit 5, x 5, linkedin 7, tiktok 7, facebook 10, instagram 20; maxCostCents is the most), funded workspaces only. At most 30 estimates and 60 platform samples an hour. Returns the estimate: when status is not done yet, poll get_keyword_estimate (usually under a minute).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

includePaid.description:
Also sample the paid platforms. See [Keyword estimates](/guides/keyword-estimates#cost).

- false (default): index numbers and free samples only; costs nothing.
- true: also the paid platforms, 2 to 20 cents per term and platform read; funded only.

matching.description: The rules the keyword would carry, as on a keyword: a sampled post must pass them to count. Omitted fields take the keyword defaults.

exactPhrase.description: true: only the exact phrase matches (a term sent in double quotes sets it). false: a multi-word keyword also matches its words close together, kept and billed only when scored relevant. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#the-exact-phrase-only).

excludedTerms.description: A post containing any of these is dropped. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (beta.* matches beta.0.1; *bot matches nightlybot).

requiredGroups.description: Combinations: the post must ALSO contain every term of at least one group (an OR of ANDs), on top of requiredTerms, with the same phrase and wildcard rules. See [Keywords](/guides/keywords#several-searches-in-one-keyword).

requiredMode.description: any: at least one required term must appear. all: every one must.

requiredTerms.description: The post must ALSO contain these terms, any one of them or all of them per requiredMode. A `*` at the start or the end of an entry is a wildcard (alert* matches alerts and alerting). Empty: no requirement.

platforms.description: The platforms the keyword would track; omit for every platform (what a new keyword tracks).

terms.description: Up to 10 candidate keywords, each estimated on its own.

items.description: A candidate keyword, as you would type it (double quotes set exactPhrase for that term).

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: estimate_keyword
title: Estimate keyword
